stem:
The graph shows afternoon temperature in $^{\circ}$C over six days.

Which claim is supported by the graph?

options.text: Temperature peaks on Day $4$ at $36^{\circ}$C, and the steepest rise is from Day $2$ to Day $3$.
Report the word trend as the Day $4$ temperature.
The peak on Day $4$ is what creates the day labels on the axis.

teacher.key_rationale: Plotted points give a peak of 36°C on Day 4; the largest rise on the shown intervals is Day 2 to Day 3 (22°C to 34°C). Naming trend as a temperature, inventing Day 7, or reversing peak and labels each go beyond the graph.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote pie-chart source into a six-day temperature line graph with a clear peak and unequal slopes.
